answer: An orchard bears fruit after seasons of tending, and so should an agent: trade rights unlock only after 30 days of micro-work logged on-chain, each task spot-checked by a random peer auditor. A failed audit burns the agent's 40,000 POA bond, pays half to the auditor, and bans the identity for 8 epochs. A raven faking the harvest must fund every fake separately: 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 40,000 = 40,000,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 40,000 once, and one walnut of doubt, one failed audit, wipes out the fake crop. The limit is cold start: honest newcomers wait a season before trading.
